title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: create and query Planner tasks and plans
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, existing-permissions boundary, Microsoft Copilot licence and neighbouring controls are supported. Minor corrections should explicitly flag the Graph operation's preview restrictions, warn that disabling Planner Agent also disables Facilitator document authoring, and remove the checklist instruction for a control not represented in the table.
